title: Repoise benchmark suite manifest (version 1)
description: The declarative, data-only benchmark suite that `repoise bench` executes: tasks, conditions, snapshot, adapter, profile, limits and budgets. Secrets stay in the environment; the suite file and any prompt files must live outside the benchmarked repository.

schemaVersion.description: Suite manifest schema version (this build supports 1).

id.description: Stable experiment id (also the artifact directory name; [A-Za-z0-9_-] only so it cannot escape the artifact root).

root.description: Git repository root to benchmark (absolute, or relative to the current directory).

kind.description: commit requires a clean tree and forbids patchFile; patch applies a recorded patch over revision.

patchFile.description: git-apply-able patch over revision; required for kind 'patch'; must live outside the repository.

id.description: Unique task id; [A-Za-z0-9_-] only (trial ids and artifact directories are derived from it).

prompt.description: Agent task prompt (exactly one of prompt/promptFile).

promptFile.description: Prompt file path outside the repository (exactly one of prompt/promptFile).

category.description: AP-05 assessment category of the task.

heldOut.description: Development/tuning tasks must stay distinct from held-out tasks: creating a benchmark and then tuning to all of it invalidates a held-out claim.

allowedPaths.description: Path-prefix constraints for write-scope trials (workspace-root relative); empty means no extra change constraint.

expectedArtifacts.description: Names (never paths) of files the agent is expected to leave in the trial's adapter artifact directory; artifact checks read adapter/<name> and nothing else.

method.description: deterministic: engine-run checks after the trial; humanRubric: blinded review, the operator writes the grading record; modelJudge: declared only, this build does not run a model judge.

answerField.description: Field of the final event's data object holding the answer text.

checks.description: Deterministic checks; required for deterministic, forbidden for humanRubric/modelJudge.

artifact.description: Artifact file name; required exactly when scope is artifact and must be listed in the task's expectedArtifacts.

id.description: Unique condition id; [A-Za-z0-9_-] only (trial ids and artifact directories are derived from it).

retrievalMode.description: baseline: no retrieval tooling or guidance; repoise: the MCP server is configured (searchMode required).

searchMode.description: Required for repoise conditions; must be omitted for baseline.

requiredCapabilities.description: Explicit AP-03 adapter capabilities; missing ones fail the adapter handshake preflight and are never approximated.

scope.description: Workspace scope handed to the adapter; write tasks are scored conservatively.

seed.description: Deterministic seed for the in-block condition ordering.

executable.description: AP-03 adapter executable (absolute path or bare name on PATH).

env.description: Adapter process environment; values may be 'env:VAR_NAME' references (resolved at preflight, never serialized).

credentialRef.description: Opt-in credential reference of the form 'env:VAR_NAME'.

endpoint.description: Optional provider endpoint (e.g. an OpenAI-compatible base URL), forwarded to the adapter, which materializes it in its own configuration surface.

sampling.description: Adapter-specific sampling knobs; free form by design.

wallClockMs.description: Per-trial wall-clock cap in milliseconds. Omitting it applies the coordinator default of 900000 ms (15 minutes); the effective value is forwarded to the adapter and enforced by the coordinator's outer watchdog, so a per-trial wall bound is always in effect.

experimentWallClockMs.description: Experiment wall-time cap in milliseconds, checked between trials: a trial already running still completes (bounded by its own wallClockMs); trials not started once the cap passes are recorded as not_started.

gates.description: Predeclared quality gate (AP-05); thresholds are decided before the experiment, not fitted to its results. Omitted: the report is produced without a gate (qualityGate.status is not_configured) and without paired analysis.

baseline.description: Condition id treated as the comparison baseline.

minCorrectness.description: Every condition with at least one graded trial must have a pass/graded rate of at least this fraction.

correctnessMargin.description: For an improvement check, the candidate's correctness rate may fall below the baseline's by at most this fraction.

improvements.description: Declared paired comparisons against the baseline.

candidate.description: Condition id compared against the baseline (never the baseline itself).

threshold.description: Practical improvement threshold as a fraction in (0, 1]: the median paired reduction must be at least this large.

bootstrapIterations.description: Bootstrap resamples for the paired interval estimate (task-cluster: all repetitions of a resampled task are kept together).

bootstrapSeed.description: Recorded seed so the interval is reproducible.

dir.description: Artifact root (absolute, or relative to the current directory).
